_note: Candidate registry for Virginia 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (Virginia Department of Elections, 2026 November Federal Offices Candidate List, November 3, 2026 General Election (updated 10/6/26; download file 2026-November-Federal-Offices-Candidate-List-(rev-10-6-2026).xlsx), linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: Virginia Department of Elections, 2026 November Federal Offices Candidate List, November 3, 2026 General Election (updated 10/6/26; download file 2026-November-Federal-Offices-Candidate-List-(rev-10-6-2026).xlsx) (https://www.elections.virginia.gov/casting-a-ballot/candidate-list/november-3-2026-gen-elect-federal-offices/); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
